rubric.question_relevance: A reviewer must check whether quoted passages actually address each expected fact; substring presence alone is not relevance.
rubric.factual_support: Every displayed decision-bearing factual claim must be an exact inspected passage excerpt with the matching source ID; unsupported paraphrases are rejected.
rubric.coverage: Missing or conflicting evidence must be explicit. A link or title without a passage supports no factual claim.
rubric.summaries: Source summaries are exact first-sentence excerpts, with full bounded passages inspectable.
rubric.acceptance: Owner must accept the answer UX; synthetic injection cannot replace actual MCP plus provider receipts.
